narrative.headline: Binance Turns To A 262.6 Million Dollar Outflow From A 98.8 Million Dollar Intake
narrative.narrative: Binance clean-asset flow turned to a 262.6 million dollar outflow from a 98.8 million dollar intake, so dollars are now leaving that venue instead of arriving. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Clean-asset intake across 79 exchanges fell to 2.0 million dollars from 280.9 million dollars, equal to 0.0007 percent of the 269.8 billion dollars held on those venues, while Bitstamp took in 297.6 million dollars and OKX sent out 41.1 million dollars.
